items.title: Energy Transition Update - Holu Hou Energy Revolutionizes MDU Solar Adoption
items.summary: Holu Hou Energy has launched the HoluPower 3.0, a solar energy storage system designed for its "EnergyCluster" platform, which targets multi-dwelling unit (MDU) housing. This development aims to overcome historical barriers to solar adoption in the MDU segment by offering a modular and cost-effective energy storage solution. items.title: Elon Musk Just Ended the Cybertruck. Will He Kill the Model 3 Next?
items.summary: Elon Musk has ended the Model S, the Model X and now the Cybertruck in one year, each to free factory space for Optimus robots or the Cybercab. The Model 3 sells about half what the Model Y does. Here is the case it could be next, in Musk's own words, and the hold-or-trim math for a couple with 1,000 Tesla shares.
